## Diabetes companion foundation

First major line beyond the Wear OS watch face (v1.0–v1.1).

### Added
- **FastAPI + PostgreSQL** backend with Gemini meal vision
- **React (Vite) web dashboard** — meals, daily/weekly reports, charts
- `docker-compose.yml` for Postgres + backend + frontend
- Mobile tabs: Glucose, Meals, Reports, Activity, Settings
- Meal capture UI, Health Connect activity import, shared nutrition/report types

### Changed
- AI provider: **Gemini** (replaces OpenAI for meal photo analysis)
- Default API port **8000**

> Retrospective release: this line was deployed live before the public monorepo ship commit. Tag points at that ship commit for history anchoring.
